annotation_policy.wrapper: Clause-local operator spans are separated from their exact source content; overlapping prefix and suffix wrappers are allowed when both functions are explicit.
annotation_policy.member: Coordination members are exact source spans. Nested coordinations are retained when an outer example member has an internal relation.
annotation_policy.connector: Every connector belonging to an annotated coordination is labeled surface, embedded, example, or quantifier after its local region is identified.
annotation_policy.scope: A shared prefix, suffix, head, evidence, or result is represented once and linked only to member spans it semantically governs.
annotation_policy.attachment: Examples attach to an explicit source parent. Terminal 等优先 never supplies the parent; an independent parent-first cue such as 如 remains valid.
annotation_policy.projection: Surface items and examples are ordered exact source strings; generic wrappers and embedded-only members are excluded.
annotation_policy.prediction_independence: The frozen selection and source_text were the only per-fixture inputs. No v4/v5 prediction was imported or executed while labeling.
